messages:
sam_ops: FYI incoming Orchid Tech H100 pallet flagged by FRA customs for invoice/serial mismatch. Depot put hold. ETA now +48h if not expedited.

nora_procure: Do we have AWB/manifest? Can Orchid reissue corrected invoice?

sam_ops: AWB: 555-11122233. Manifest range shows H100-5001..H100-5030 but invoice lists 1..28. Uploaded photos and manifest to s3: s3://redwood-procure/orchid/1765001234/evidence.zip

lee_infra: EU dedicated pool will be ~15% below planned capacity if these stay quarantined through weekend. We should identify minimal set of customers to prioritize.

tess_product: We'll need a short customer-facing note about limited capacity and mitigations. Keep tone factual.

nora_procure: Orchid offered an air-rebook with forwarder SkyLynx for 15 units next-day but surcharge = 5000 and they ask Redwood to cover customs brokerage.

sam_ops: Proposal: Redwood pays brokerage up to 3000; Orchid covers the remainder and we split speed surcharge 50/50. That would get 15 units in ~24h.

lee_infra: 15 units buys enough buffer to avoid SLA breaches if we throttle batch jobs and shift non-critical workloads to us-west for 36h. Can ops tag which jobs to deprioritize?

tess_product: Yes, we'll create a routing rule to shift low-priority customers and flag reserved capacity holders for notification.

finbot: Finance approval required for any payment > 000. Please ping @oliver_finance.

nora_procure: I can pre-authorize 2500 from procurement float. Need finance signoff for rest. Looping in Oliver.

sam_ops: Also need corrected invoice into customs before release. Orchid says they can reissue within 2h if we accept cost split.

lee_infra: On the infra side: I'll prepare a quick Grafana snapshot of EU queue and expected reduction after 15 units. ETA 10m.

tess_product: Draft customer bullets: 1) Brief regional capacity impact in EU for 24-48h. 2) Cross-region burst to US activated. 3) No data exposure. 4) We'll follow up in 12h.

nora_procure: Oliver_finance: can you authorize up to 2500 while we finalize the vendor amendment? @oliver_finance

finbot: Finance escalated. Oliver asked for vendor amendment and AWB before commit.

sam_ops: Orchid uploaded revised invoice and AWB to s3: s3://redwood-procure/orchid/1765001234/invoice_v2.pdf AWB: 555-11122299

nora_procure: Vendor agreed to 50/50 surcharge split and to cover brokerage if we commit to a Q4 reorder of 100 units. They're asking for a short LOA. Legal review needed.

lee_infra: If finance greenlights, ops can coordinate SkyLynx pickup. Once serials scan into inventory we'll mark them "eu-edge-ready" and update customers.

finbot: Oliver approved up to 2500 pending LOA/legal review. Please attach LOA draft to #legal.

sam_ops: LOA sent to legal. Depot scheduled SkyLynx pickup tonight. I'll update when depot scans show serials scanned.

tess_product: Holding customer note until we have confirmation of 15 units scanned. Then we'll send a neutral update with mitigation steps.

sam_ops: Depot scanned 15 units into inventory: H100-5001..H100-5015. Tagging inventory HOLD-ORCHID-1765001234 cleared 15 units. ETA for remaining 15 depends on manifest consolidation.

nora_procure: Closing loop: agreed cost split, LOA signed, vendor to schedule remaining equipment consolidation at FRA. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
